name: SelectNative
summary: Style a visible native select while retaining native form and option behavior.

useWhen: Using native option, optgroup, keyboard, form, and reset behavior with Mux field styling.
avoidWhen: Requiring a custom popup listbox or collection-driven selection model; use Select.

obligations: Provide label, aria-label, or aria-labelledby; optional description and error content is associated through internal React Aria useField.
Keep the visible control a native HTMLSelectElement and preserve option, optgroup, multiple, keyboard, ref, change, form, and reset behavior.
Use string size for Mux visual sizing; a numeric size remains the native list size and does not get discarded.

behavior: Renders a genuine visible native select with caller options and optgroups unchanged.

Internal useField supplies deterministic label, description, and error associations while native value/defaultValue/onChange, name, disabled, required, multiple, ref, form submit, and reset remain native.
String sm, md, and lg values select Mux visual targets; a positive integer numeric size is forwarded as the native list size with md visual styling.
accessibility: The native select receives the generated or caller-supplied label and description IDs.
Invalid and required states remain exposed through native and ARIA attributes; focus remains on the native select.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
